title: distinguish optional required
name: Distinguish optional required — NN/g
rule: Distinguish optional and required fields; limit optional fields and label them as optional.
pass_when: Optional vs required is visible; optional fields are few and labeled optional.
fail_when: Mix of optional and required with no marking, or many unlabeled optionals.
overview: Mark optional versus required; keep optionals few and labeled optional.
apply_when: Forms mix required and optional fields users must tell apart.
not_when: All-required short forms with no optional fields present.
agent_hint: Mark optional vs required; label optionals and keep them few.
description: Users need a clear distinction between optional and required fields. Limit optional fields and label them as optional so the mix is not ambiguous. Pass when optional versus required is visible and optionals are few and labeled; fail when the mix has no marking, or many unlabeled optionals sit on the form. Derive marking from the field set users actually see, not from backend-only constraints.
do_not_claim: NN/g mark-optional (`forms.fields.distinguish_optional_required`) as a winner. Overlap with Forms 54: `forms.fields.distinguish_optional_required`.
